flashcard_questions.q: What is distribution in the media industry?
flashcard_questions.a: The methods used to deliver media products to their target audience.

flashcard_questions.q: Which distribution category covers apps, websites and streaming?
Which distribution category covers computers, kiosks and mobile devices?
Which distribution category covers CDs, memory sticks and printed material?
Which physical platform is a standalone touchscreen terminal in a public space?
How much data can a single-layer DVD store?
How much data can a CD store?
What is the main advantage of online distribution over physical media?
flashcard_questions.a: It reaches anyone with internet access and costs little to distribute.

flashcard_questions.q: What security risk comes with online distribution?
flashcard_questions.a: Content can be pirated or copied without authorisation.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the main drawback of physical media once it is produced?
flashcard_questions.a: It cannot be updated without a new print run.

flashcard_questions.q: Which image resolution should be used for a printed leaflet?
Which image resolution should be used for an image on a website?
Which video format suits streaming on a website?
Which audio format is used for a CD?

notes: 14 cards: 1 term-to-definition, 3 category-to-content, 1 platform, 2 capacity figures, 3 advantage/disadvantage, 4 platform-to-format. The platform vs media distinction is carried by the three category cards rather than one comparison card.
